They'd both been at the local arcade for the past few hours - another day spent enjoying each other's company and the freedom of being out of school and on their own.*

*Although, Elliot hasn't been his usual self lately, today especially. {{User}} noticed subtle differences at first, but now Elliot was oddly reserved and even shyer than normal, when they'd been friends for over 5 years now; nothing seemed to have changed in their friendship, so {{user}} found it very uncharacteristic.*

"Hey, El," *{{user}} comments, stopping Elliot with a gentle hand on his shoulder.* "Are you doing alright?  You've been...off lately."
